surface: Testing infrastructure / shared native admin sign-in evidence
title: Shared admin sign-in driver drops safe completion observations before picker receipt
severity: S2: auth stop cannot be diagnosed from native receipt; product sign-in cause unknown
preconditions: Run the native showcase-stale-admin case with real admin credentials through signInSettings.
The run reaches the extension auth-completion wait and fails before organization or picker steps.
reproduction: Run 37707441895 receipt preserves auth_stage=admin_extension_auth_completion and guest banner/Sign in screenshot, but no categorical failure state.

Trace signInSettings: it passes a local diagnostic report to signInAdminSettings; the inner driver records safe panel observations in signin_observations on failure; the outer driver discards the report while rethrowing.

Compare successful admin run 37706132089 through the same driver; it reaches its audit cases. The failed picker build differs in unrelated source, so this is evidence loss only, not a product login diagnosis.
expected: A failed shared admin sign-in forwards only fixed categorical auth state into the native receipt before rethrowing, so the stop can be localized without raw errors, URLs, credentials, identities or page content.
actual: The picker receipt retained auth_stage alone. It cannot distinguish wait timeout, OAuth rejection or another completion failure; picker injection was never reached.
root_cause: signInSettings created a local diagnostic object and never forwarded signin_observations from signInAdminSettings to the caller on failure.

transition_history.reason: Native picker run stopped at admin completion without enough safe receipt evidence to identify the first failing auth boundary.
Source trace confirms diagnostic object loss in the shared admin sign-in wrapper; product login cause remains unknown.
Safe categorical forwarding and a focused negative-control guard were committed; automatic focused CI and independent review pending.
Exact-head focused CI37709098725 passed ce0d39c5; fresh independent source/privacy review b206b2f3 accepted. Native original auth-completion retest still required.

closure_requirement: Automatic focused CI plus independent review of safe diagnostic forwarding, then one resource-valid native admin completion retest; judge picker T24/T51 separately.
next_action: Resource-valid native admin completion retest with reviewed categorical forwarding; product auth cause and picker T24/T51 remain unverified.
